source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals

parameters_passed_to_the_agent.search_scope: Open and forthcoming EU calls for proposals that are relevant to the energy sector in any way. Programmes to cover: Horizon Europe (mainly Cluster 5 'Climate, Energy and Mobility', Cluster 4 'Digital, Industry and Space', Cluster 3 'Civil Security for Society', Cluster 6 where a topic concerns the offshore or marine environment, the European Innovation Council, the Missions, and the European Partnerships and Joint Undertakings such as Clean Hydrogen), the Connecting Europe Facility for Energy, the Innovation Fund, the LIFE Clean Energy Transition sub-programme and the Digital Europe Programme. Each topic is its own FO, with the topic ID (for example HORIZON-CL5-2027-D3-01-05) as the call reference; the call ID (for example HORIZON-CL5-2027-D3-01) groups related topics. Skip calls for tenders, cascade funding calls, calls for experts, and I3 Instrument topics (they have their own source file).
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.navigation_instructions: 1. The portal is a JavaScript application. A plain page fetch returns an empty shell with no results, so use a browser. 2. Open the starting URL and set the filters: Status 'Open' and 'Forthcoming' (not 'Closed'), programming period 2021-2027, then one programme from the search scope at a time. The status filter is also in the address: status=31094502 is Open, 31094501 is Forthcoming, 31094503 is Closed. Example for Horizon Europe, open and forthcoming: https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-for-proposals?order=DESC&pageNumber=1&pageSize=50&sortBy=startDate&isExactMatch=true&status=31094501,31094502&programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027&frameworkProgramme=43108390 3. Horizon Europe has several hundred open and forthcoming topics. Narrow it with the programme part filter (the clusters, EIC, Missions, partnerships) named in the search scope, or with keywords such as energy, electricity, grid, transmission, offshore, flexibility, storage, hydrogen, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital twin and artificial intelligence. 4. Set the page size to 50 and work through every result page. Screen each result by its title and topic ID, and open only those that could concern the energy sector. 5. Each result opens a topic page at .../screen/opportunities/topic-details/<TOPIC-ID>. It holds the general information (status, type of action, opening date, deadline or deadlines, single-stage or two-stage), the topic description (expected outcome and scope), the conditions and documents (eligible countries, the Work Programme part as PDF, templates), the budget overview and the topic updates. 6. The Work Programme part (PDF) is the authoritative text for eligibility, TRL, budget per project and conditions. The topic updates list amendments and deadline changes; compare them with what the FO record already holds. 7. TenneT TSO B.V. is a Dutch legal entity, so the Netherlands' eligibility is what matters; topics restricted to other countries or regions are out of scope.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.link_scope: Pages under ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/ (result lists, topic pages, budget overviews, call documents), and Work Programme or call documents linked from a topic page on other europa.eu websites (for example a Joint Undertaking's call page). Do not follow links to the submission system, partner search, login pages, news, or websites outside europa.eu.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.completion_rules: The run is complete when, for every programme in the search scope, every page of the Open and Forthcoming results has been screened and every relevant topic has been opened. If the run's search limit is reached first, stop and report the programme, the filters and the page number where you stopped, so the next run can start there.
